title: Hakuna Matata & Motunui Boat Cruises by Visit Palm Beach

services.name: Moonlight Cruise
services.desc: Prepare to drink in the breathtaking Downtown WPB skyline by moonlight on the Hakuna Matata Catamaran! 90 minutes About Set sail on a magical 90-minute moonlit cruise aboard the Hakuna Matata Catamaran, departing from Downtown West Palm Beach. Glide along the scenic Palm Beach coastline while marveling at the breathtaking city skyline illuminated against the night sky. Enjoy refreshing beverages, lively music, and an unforgettable atmosphere—perfect for groups, celebrations, or anyone looking for a fun and relaxing evening on the water. Whether you're gathering friends or making new 90 Minutes • All Ages

From a breathtaking sunset or dinner cruise to a sandbar Floatila party, a private charter party Cruise is the 2-8 Hour Options • All Ages • Up to 49 Passengers

services.desc: Join Us for a No Worries Family Cruise! services.name: Hakuna Matata Holiday Pirate Cruise
services.desc: Family Friendly Intracoastal Cruise with Pirate fun, treasure and adventure! 1.5 Hours About Ahoy, Mateys and Mermaids! Are you ready for a Holiday in Paradise adventure on the high seas? Join Visit Palm Beach for a 90-minute family-friendly Pirate and Mermaid-themed catamaran cruise aboard Visit Palm Beach’s 50’ Catamaran “Hakuna Matata”. Every Saturday from 3:00-4:30pm in December 2023, you can enjoy the scenic and mystic views of Palm Beach, interact with our friendly and fun-loving pirate crew, play games, win prizes, and have a swashbuckling good time. Don’t miss this Adults $40 · Children $30 · 1.5 hours

services.desc: 🌺 Mother’s Day Polynesian Sunset Cruise – Celebrate Mom in Island Style! 🌺 This Mother’s Day, treat mom to an unforgettable evening aboard our Polynesian-themed Sunset Cruise along the beautiful coastline of Palm Beach Island. With just 49 guests on board, this exclusive experience blends stunning views, festive vibes, and delicious dining for a celebration she’ll always remember. 🌅 What’s Included: 🎶 Island Vibe Music Feel the tropical rhythm with feel-good island tunes setting the mood for a joyful, relaxing evening. 🍹 Full Cash/Credit Bar: Sip on handcrafted cocktails, premium wines, Adults $59 · Children $25 · 2 hours

services.name: Motunui Mother's Day Brunchtime Cruise
services.desc: Celebrate the extraordinary woman in your life with our Mother's Day Brunchtime Catamaran Cruise departing from Downtown West Palm Beach. Treat your mom to a morning of relaxation, indulgence, and breathtaking views as we cruise along the stunning Palm Beach coastline. Experience Highlights: 🍽️ Brunch Boxes: Pre-order one of our curated brunch boxes, salads, sandwiches, or wraps for a delicious and hassle-free dining experience! 🥂 Bottomless Drink Option: Elevate your experience with our bottomless Mimosa or Rum Punch option, available for purchase in advance or onboard for an additional Adults $59 · Children $25 · 2 hours

services.name: Off Shore Fishing
services.desc: Local Sportfishing Charters – Palm Beach’s Premier Offshore Fishing Adventure Step aboard our 40’ Invincible Catamaran and experience the ultimate offshore fishing charter in Palm Beach! Designed for serious anglers and thrill-seekers alike, this high-performance fishing machine combines speed, stability, and comfort for an unforgettable day on the water. Powered by four Yamaha 300s (1200hp), she cruises at 40 mph and can hit speeds of over 60 mph — getting you to the fishing grounds fast. We specialize in targeting Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Wahoo, Kingfish, Sailfish, Snapper, Grouper, Cobia, and many 4 hour Deep Sea Fishing

services.name: Intro to Kayak or Paddleboard Lesson
services.desc: Paddling 101 for Beginners! $75 per person per hour 1-4 Hours - Pricing Varies About Are you or your family interested in learning or improving your kayaking or paddleboarding skills and don't know where to start? Want to learn a new sport that gets you outside, exploring and exercising safely? Our expert guides and instructors will cover how to kayak and paddle, entry and exit a kayak, how to stay “sunny side up” or upright, paddling strokes (forward, reverse, sideways, turning strokes), what to do if you tip over, what equipment do I really need, and where to paddle in the From $75 per Person per Hour · 1-4 Hour Options

quotes.author: Katie
quotes.text: My fiance and I joined the West Palm Beach Sunset cruise one evening as a date night. We live in West Palm, and at first, we were a bit hesitant it would be super touristy. We were so wrong! It was absolutely lovely! We packed a cooler and enjoyed wine along with cheese and crackers. The staff was incredible, and I am looking into renting the boat for a team building event for my coworkers. We absolutely loved it and look forward to bringing more people with us on our next excursion!

quotes.author: Rosie
quotes.text: We took the Hakuna Matata on the sunset cruise, and we couldn't have asked for a more perfect experience. We had family in from OK and we had never sailed on the catamaran even though we're locals. ‍‍‍The captain and staff were super knowledgeable and friendly. The weather was ideal for a cruise and our views of the sunset could only have improved on the west coast. Highly recommend it to ‍‍‍tourists and locals alike.‍‍‍

quotes.author: MrFfordCT
quotes.text: It was just so simple, so nice, staff were great, super clean boat, fun...and an amazing value (shhhhhh--they may charge more!) If you are not up for going out on a boat the whole day, this two hour tour is perfect for getting fresh air on the water, dancing to cool reggae tunes, watching the sunset, and drinking your favorite drink! Happy to do this again as we are down in WPB often.

quotes.author: Sandy
quotes.text: Thank you so much for teaching me about the history of WPB....very enjoyable tour... I will definitely spread the word. Can’t wait to return and dine at The Ben and/or Elizabetas. See you soon

quotes.author: Effie Y
quotes.text: A must ride attraction well in West Palm Beach! We brought our 5 teenagers along with us and this is one we would all love to go on again. The staff was friendly, accommodating, informative and the boat was very clean. I recommend trying the staffs house punch which is available to purchase on the boat.
